title: Program Manager, Performance Effectiveness
description:
About the role

We're hiring a Program Manager, Performance Effectiveness to help improve how we measure, manage, and drive performance across Chime's Member Experience organization. You'll work closely with BPO partners, operational leaders, and cross-functional teams to turn performance data into meaningful improvements for our frontline teams and members. This is a high-impact opportunity to build scalable performance frameworks and influence operational strategy through analytics, automation, and continuous improvement. You'll also help shape how we use emerging AI-driven evaluation tools to improve quality and operational effectiveness at scale.

In this role, you can expect to

• Build and operationalize scalable performance effectiveness frameworks across BPO teams, including consistent scorecards and evaluation methodologies.

• Partner with BPO vendors and internal operational leaders to identify performance gaps, drive accountability, and improve outcomes.

• Analyze manual audits, speech analytics, and operational reporting to uncover trends and turn insights into actionable recommendations.

• Develop and maintain performance dashboards, scorecards, and business review materials that help leadership make informed decisions.

• Identify opportunities to continuously improve processes, performance monitoring tools, and member experience workflows.

• Collaborate with operations, analytics, Member Experience, and other business teams to align performance strategy and execution.

• Help improve the adoption and effectiveness of performance evaluation tools, including opportunities to leverage automation and AI-driven capabilities.

To thrive in this role, you have

• 3+ years of experience in contact center quality, performance management, or operational effectiveness.

• Demonstrated success driving measurable performance improvements with BPO vendors or internal operations teams.

• Strong analytical skills and an ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

• Experience building or managing performance scorecards, dashboards, or reporting frameworks that help teams make better decisions.

• The ability to navigate ambiguity and partner effectively with stakeholders across global teams.

• Strong organizational, project management, and communication skills, with experience driving cross-functional initiatives.

• Nice to have: Experience working with AI/ML-driven evaluation systems, such as LLM-based scoring, automation tools, or classification models.

title: IT Logistics Lead
description:
About the Team

Employee Technology & Experience helps people at OpenAI do their most ambitious work. Across Helpdesk, Executive Support, Systems Operations, Logistics and audiovisual services, we make technology simple, reliable and secure. Employee needs guide what we build, improve and eliminate.

IT Logistics keeps employees equipped, from day 1 readiness to timely replacements and self-service peripherals. We manage the full equipment lifecycle and improve access to hardware as employee needs evolve.

About the Role

We’re hiring an IT Logistics Lead to manage the team that keeps OpenAI employees equipped for their most important work. You’ll run daily operations, evaluate new hardware and introduce equipment and services that address unmet needs.

You’ll own the hardware and peripheral catalog, fulfillment programs, asset management systems and regional operating models. You’ll deliver on IT’s promise: equipment ready on day 1 globally, choices suited to each employee’s location and work, self-service employees trust, and accurate records of what we own, where it is and who has it.

This is a hands-on people management role. You’ll coach team members, manage performance and work alongside them on execution and escalations. With your manager, you’ll set priorities and plan capacity. As customer zero, you’ll use OpenAI products to solve unresolved logistics problems, continually improving accuracy and shortening lead times.

In this role, you will:

- Own a hardware and peripheral catalog that keeps pace with employee needs, with new equipment options and devices ready for use with current, validated software images and configurations.

- Deliver day 1 readiness globally, with equipment suited to each employee’s location and work. Ensure timely fulfillment, refreshes, replacements, loaners, telecom and mobility, and high-risk travel services as offices and programs expand.

- Own and scale the employee IT vending machine program and other self-service channels as services employees trust, with the right peripherals available, machines working every time and tightly managed shrinkage.

- Own asset accountability across the full lifecycle, with 100% accurate records that reconcile to physical inventory and trusted chain of custody from receipt through recovery, reuse and secure disposition.

- Own forecasting, capacity and logistics performance to continually improve accuracy, shorten lead times and keep equipment available. Control lifecycle costs, reduce excess stock and waste, and maintain service through supply disruptions.

- Use OpenAI products, including Codex and agents, as customer zero to solve previously unresolved logistics problems and improve accuracy, speed and scale, with appropriate evaluation, security and human oversight.

- Manage and develop team members so each person builds skills, takes ownership and delivers excellent work. Build team and delivery partner capability that sustains quality and consistency as demand grows.

- Scale service globally with accountable regional partners and repeatable operations that meet local needs while maintaining speed, inventory accuracy and a consistent employee experience.

- Keep daily operations reliable as demand changes, with timely escalation resolution, capacity and commitments aligned with your manager, and clear decision ownership across engineering, security, support, workplace, finance and procurement.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- Led inventory and fulfillment across multiple sites or regions, owning forecasting, delivery partners, service performance and cost, with sustained improvements in accuracy, reconciliation, shrinkage, availability and lead times.

- Delivered automation and AI-enabled workflows used in daily operations, including solutions to previously unresolved problems. You can explain your contribution, measurable results, reliability testing, security controls and human oversight.

title: Medical Director, Virtual Urgent Care & On-Demand Telehealth (Build & Scale 24/7
description:
Job Description

Skills and Experience:

• Board-certified physician (emergency medicine, internal medicine, or family medicine preferred) with 5+ years in clinical practice, willing to continue practicing in a virtual care setting.

• Experience leading and managing clinicians, including advanced practice providers.

• Experience building or scaling a clinical program or service line, not just operating within one.

• Comfort working with engineering, product, and data teams. You don't need to write code, but you need to think clearly about how technology shapes care delivery.

• Experience designing interventions to improve population health outcomes and an understanding of how to measure and track care quality.

• Experience working in interdisciplinary teams across clinical and non-clinical functions.

• Experience with virtual care, Medicare populations, or urgent care preferred.

A bit more about this role:
Devoted Medical, Devoted Health 's virtual-first, AI-native medical group delivering multi-specialty and advanced primary care, is seeking a dynamic, experienced, and mission-driven Physician Leader to serve as the Medical Director, Care Ondemand. This is a highly impactful position: you will serve as the clinical leader of a portfolio of clinical services that serves as the clinical backbone in our organization. This includes leading our virtual primary care extension, virtual urgent care, virtual observation unit (episodic care). The service operates 24/7 and ensures that all members of Devoted Health have a way to access care.

This represents an amazing opportunity for an ambitious clinician-leader with an entrepreneurial streak. As the Medical Director for Care Ondemand, you are responsible for building a team and an operation to handle the acute and routine needs of our membership. Specifically, you will provide clinical leadership for the 3 layers of Devoted’s Care Ondemand Program: (1) Care OnDemand - inbound triage and virtual / digital immediate care (2) Primary Care Extension- enterprise wide immediate care support for low acuity PCP extension care (3) Virtual Observation Unit - multi-day care of acute clinical issues (e.g. CHF exacerbation or complicated infections) by an interprofessional team. All functions of the service are supported by a rapidly expanding digital platform and AI-powered care tools.

In short, we want to build an unprecedented access point to care and meet the needs of our members in a way they thought imaginable - well before they feel compelled to use urgent care or the emergency room unnecessarily.

On a day to day basis, you’d be responsible for:

• Developing and evolving the vision for the service line including expansion into increasingly AI-enabled digital channels

• Clinical architect of the care model

• Provide direct patient care and available for clinical escalations

• Direct leadership of the clinical managers - and indirectly the entire Care on Demand clinical staff (RN, NP, MDs)

• Managing vendors and technology needed to achieve success (e.g. mobile radiology, mobile phlebotomy)

• Coordinating with Devoted’s network leaders and community primary care practices to ensure continuity and cohesive care

• Cross-functional coordination within Devoted (e.g. Marketing) to promote utilization of the service line

Who thrives in this role:

• You are an excellent clinician who cares deeply about the well-being of your patients and brings strong judgment to both clinical and operational decisions.

• You are a builder. You can stand up a new service line from scratch and manage all the parts: people, operations, vendors, technology, and cross-organizational coordination.

• You are energized by AI and technology and see them as tools to make care better, not threats to the craft of medicine.

• You are a happy warrior. In a great environment with smart, caring people working toward a common aim, you are comfortable working hard.

• You are wired for learning, change, and rap

title: Software Engineer, Unsecured Installments
description:
About Upstart

At Upstart , we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstart ers the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:
Unsecured Installments is one of Upstart 's core lending products, helping borrowers access credit through a seamless, digitally native experience. The team owns critical parts of the borrower journey across offer generation, pricing, underwriting, funding, and borrower experience, while working closely with the broader lending platform that powers Upstart at scale. Recent work has focused on improving borrower flows, repricing and rate flexibility, partnership experiences, and the overall quality of the customer-facing experience.
As a Senior Software Engineer on the Unsecured Installments team, you'll be a technical leader for the frontend and full-stack experiences that borrowers interact with directly. Working primarily in React and TypeScript, you'll own the delivery of large, multi-month projects, shape the architecture of the team's mobile-web and full-stack surfaces, and set a high bar for quality across the borrower experience. You'll partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to turn ambiguous problems into durable, well-architected solutions, and you'll mentor other engineers along the way.
How you’ll make an impact

• Own the design and delivery of large, complex frontend and full-stack initiatives using React and TypeScript, from planning and sequencing through launch and long-term maintenance.

• Set technical direction for the team's frontend architecture and full-stack patterns, owning a 3-6 month roadmap and proactively addressing systemic gaps that threaten team effectiveness.

• Partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to translate roadmap priorities and borrower needs into scalable, high-quality experiences.

• Raise the bar for engineering excellence through strong component and API design, thoughtful state management, testing, observability, and operational rigor across borrower-facing surfaces.

• Lead through ambiguity, breaking down loosely defined problems into clear, testable plans and using data to inform tradeoffs on scope, performance, and user experience.

• Mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance, and serve as a trusted collaborator across the team.

• Contribute to how the team uses AI in development workflows and product capabilities, with a pragmatic view of where it can create meaningful leverage.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science

•

Measure and optimize impact: Establish reporting on buying-group engagement, qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, and revenue impact. Share results and recommendations with sales and marketing stakeholders, test new approaches, and document what works in reusable ABM playbooks.

What you bring with you

•
Relevant B2B marketing experience: Five or more years in B2B technology marketing, including at least two years building and executing ABM programs. You can point to programs that generated quality pipeline, accelerated opportunities, or supported customer growth.

A strong partnership with sales: You understand enterprise buying cycles and how to engage multiple stakeholders within an account. You’ve worked closely with sales teams to turn account priorities into coordinated marketing activity.

Our mission is to expand educational equity for multilingual learners by increasing the supply of high-quality instructional materials that center on their cultural and linguistic assets.

The CSE&I also drives how ELSF communicates its impact to key stakeholders, partners, and the broader education ecosystem.

Leadership and Organizational Integration

description:
About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $136M ARR and is the leading specialized storage cloud, managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We’re seeking a Vulnerability Management Engineer to join our team!

About the Role

The Vulnerability Management Engineer drives risk-based vulnerability and exposure management across infrastructure, applications, cloud services, endpoints, and software dependencies. The role combines vulnerability data, asset and configuration intelligence, application-security testing, threat intelligence, and AI-assisted analysis to determine whether vulnerabilities are reachable, exploitable, and likely to represent an imminent organizational threat.

Key Responsibilities

• Correlate threat intelligence and vulnerability findings with asset inventory, software configuration, system configuration, application testing, network exposure, ownership, and business criticality.

• Assess exploitability and reachability rather than relying on vulnerability severity alone.

title: Post-doctorant.e en conception de catalyseurs bimétalliques et multifonctionnels pour la conversion directe du CO2 en carburants liquides (H/F) – CDD 11 mois
description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :
École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.
Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.
IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.
Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs.
Le poste est ouvert dans le fond propre d’IMT Mines Albi. Une collaboration avec le laboratoire de chimie de coordination (LCC) à Toulouse est prévue.

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :
A ce jour, les carburants fossiles sont encore largement utilisés dans les différents secteurs industriels et notamment pour le secteur de transport, qui sont une source importante d’émission de gaz à effet de serre. Pour réduire l’impact environnemental du secteur de transport, les carburants de synthèse jouent un rôle important, en particulier pour le transport aérien de demain. Parmi les voies de R&D étudiées à ce jour pour la production de ces carburants de synthèse, le captage du CO2 et l’hydrogénation directe de ce CO2 par de l’hydrogène obtenu par l’électrolyse de l’eau avec de l’électricité renouvelable est une voie stratégique. L'un de leurs atouts majeurs réside dans l’optimisation de la production pour minimiser le coût du produit final, et la compatibilité des carburants de synthèse avec les infrastructures et les flottes existantes.
Ce projet, qui réunit deux laboratoires (RAPSODEE à Albi, et LCC à Toulouse), vise à produire des carburants alternatifs par hydrogénation directe du CO2 via une synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch à partir de CO2 (CO2-FTS). Ce processus se décompose en deux étapes successives : (i) l'hydrogénation du CO2 en CO (réaction inverse du gaz à l'eau, ou RWGS), suivie (ii) de l'hydrogénation du CO en hydrocarbures (synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch, ou FTS). Ce projet continue la recherche récente entre les deux laboratoires sur le même sujet, en développant des systèmes catalytiques multifonctionnels assurant la conversion, en une seule étape, dans un seul réacteur et à une seule condition de température et de pression, du CO2 et H2 en carburants liquides. Une attention particulière sera accordée à l’ingénierie de la composition, de la structure et de l’environnement des sites actifs, afin d’établir des relations structure-activité et de comprendre le rôle de chaque composant métallique dans les différentes étapes réactionnelles. Cette stratégie vise à dépasser les limitations des catalyseurs conventionnels en améliorant leur activité, sélectivité, stabilité et résistance à la désactivation. Le projet contribuera ainsi au développement d’une nouvelle génération de catalyseurs multifonctionnels pour la valorisation directe et durable du CO2 en carburants et produits chimiques à valeur ajoutée.

title: Supplier Quality Engineer
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) - Composite Materials responsible for supplier quality ownership of composite materials and components, ensuring process robustness, material integrity, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement across the supply base.

This role emphasizes process capability, risk mitigation, and supplier maturity. The SQE will participate in supplier qualification, process validation, and technical quality assessments, acting as a primary interface between suppliers, engineering, manufacturing, NDT, and program quality to ensure reliable and repeatable composite manufacturing. The role requires a hands-on approach with frequent presence at supplier facilities.

Key Responsibilities:

• Execute supplier quality performance monitoring throughout the lifecycle: development, qualification, and serial production.
• Support the qualification of new composite suppliers through capability assessments, readiness reviews, and audits.
• Conduct system, process, and special process audits, including composite layup, curing, machining, and bonding.
• Monitor supplier performance using scorecards, KPIs, and structured improvement roadmaps.
• Ensure control of composite manufacturing through monitoring of Critical Process Parameters (CPPs), Key Characteristics (KCs), process windows, and repeatability.
• Perform First Article Inspection (FAI) and process validation per AS9102 and AST SpaceMobile requirements.
• Identify and report supplier risks using PFMEA and process risk assessments.
• Review and approve material certifications, CoCs, process control plans, and quality records.
• Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and internal standards.
• Provide technical support for NDT activities (UT, C-scan, RT, thermography), including results review against defined criteria.
• Assist in quality technical investigations (voids, delamination, bonding failures) and track root cause and CAPA implementation.
• Act as a quality liaison for composite suppliers.
• Advise internal stakeholders on supplier capabilities and process observations.
• Maintain knowledge of composite technologies, including prepreg layup, resin infusion/RTM, autoclave and OOA curing.
• Up to 50% of the time will be spent traveling to and working on-site at supplier locations to ensure direct oversight and process verification.

Qualifications

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent.

Experience:
A minimum of 3-5 years of Supplier Quality Engineering experience, with knowledge of composite materials and special processes.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience in aerospace or space-grade composite structures.
• Hands-on involvement with composite NDT and acceptance criteria.
• Familiarity with ECSS / ESA / NASA or equivalent aerospace standards.
• Experience with high-reliability or safety-critical products.

Soft Skills:
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Strong communication skills.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently in a supplier-facing environment.
• Detail-oriented and hands-on approach.
• Strong interpersonal skills for frequent supplier interaction.
• Ability to manage multiple suppliers and prioritize field tasks.
• Data-driven, process-oriented approach to quality.

Technology Stack:
• PFMEA
• AS9102
• AS9100
• NADCAP
• NDT methods including UT, C-scan, RT, and thermography

Physical Requirements

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. As our next Senior Software Engineer in Trust & Safety, you'll own the systems that decide how tradespeople are checked, how reviews are processed and how our marketplace stays honest at scale. You'll work alongside the vetting and reviews teams, who are on the front line of trust, and build the infrastructure that lets them work with confidence. When something breaks in production, you'll lead the response. When something looks brittle at design time, you'll say so.

The job, unfiltered:

- Own and evolve the systems behind how tradespeople are verified, how reviews flow through our platform and how content is moderated.

- Lead the response when things break: read distributed traces, correlate logs across services and find the cause, not just the symptom.

- Design event-driven workflows that are reliable by default: idempotent, retryable, with dead-letter handling that doesn't need a 2am wake-up to unpick.

- Work directly with the vetting and reviews teams to understand what trust means day to day, then build systems that hold up to it.

- Tighten the operational seams: better monitoring, clearer alerting, locked-down auth and outbox patterns that keep data consistent.

The fit:

- Strong TypeScript. You're comfortable owning a service end to end, from schema to deployment.

- Fastify or a similar Node.js framework, and enough HTTP know-how that it rarely surprises you.

- Event-driven instincts: you know what idempotency means in practice and why the outbox pattern exists.

- Full-stack comfort, Next.js included. You ship the frontend as happily as the service behind it.

- Datadog fluency (APM traces, log search, metric queries), SQL for diagnostics during an incident, and GCP basics such as Pub/Sub backlogs and DLQs.

- Experience leading production incidents, not just being in them. You communicate clearly under pressure and drive to a fix.

- An eye for systemic problems at review time, not at post-mortem time, and a habit of making the people around you better.

- Regular use of AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, and a keen interest in helping the team get more out of them.

You don't need to know our Trust & Safety domain yet (the review lifecycle, vetting disposition logic, publish timing). You'll pick it up. What matters is that you learn fast and take it seriously.

title: Senior Forecasting Administrator
description:

At HelloConnect, you will be part of a dynamic team in Inoza tower, BGC that embraces innovation and leverages advanced technology to create exceptional experiences. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects, develop your skills, and grow within a supportive environment that values diverse perspectives and experiences.

In this role, you will take on a key responsibility in ensuring accurate and reliable BAU forecasts through SQL-based data validation, investigation of discrepancies and anomalies, analytical reporting, and the development of standardized processes to improve forecasting efficiency and support future automation. contributing to our ongoing efforts to drive business success and enhance customer satisfaction.

• Develop, maintain, and execute SQL queries to validate forecast data, ensuring the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of forecast inputs and outputs.

Operations

title: Senior Salesforce Engineer
description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Salesforce Engineer to join our team full-time in Poland.
We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
About the role:
As a Senior Salesforce Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.
The company is on an incredible journey to become the universal symbol of trust. As the world's largest independent consumer review platform, they bring consumers and businesses together to foster transparency and improvement. With over 300 million reviews and 64 million monthly active users, the work we do together has a massive global impact, helping millions of people make better choices every day. In this role, you will join the Go To Market department within the Technology organization. You will be pivotal in delivering large strategic projects and change requests across the Salesforce platform, supporting commercial, marketing, ops, and customer service teams. You will work as a key link with the business-wide team responsible for the entire company’s Salesforce ecosystem, working with a proactive approach to operational excellence, system architecture, code quality, and process automation.
Responsibilities:

• Salesforce Development & Architecture: Design, develop, and implement custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and platform automation (Flows)

• Integrations & APIs: Build and maintain secure integrations between Salesforce and internal/external systems using REST, SOAP, and various API integration patterns

• Declarative & Automated Solutions: Develop and maintain complex Salesforce Flows and process automations, balancing programmatic capabilities with declarative best practices for optimal performance and scalable architecture

• Collaborative Engineering & Peer Review: Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, unit testing, and quality assurance alongside the cross-functional GTM Tech team and broader Salesforce engineering ecosystem

• DevOps & Delivery: Apply change management via standard CI/CD pipelines, using version control tools (e.g., GitHub) and deployment workflows for smooth project delivery

• Documentation & Compliance: Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, system auditing evidence, and integration/customization processes

• Team Growth & Support: Collaborate closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders, provide support and guidance to junior team members/administrators, and contribute to an inclusive knowledge-sharing environment

Requirements:

• We are looking for engineers with a strong background in Salesforce development and apassion for high-quality, scalable code

• Experience: 6+ years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Developer & Administrator, specifically with Salesforce Service Cloud

• Core Declarative & Programmatic Skills: Expert proficiency in Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, and platform automation tools (Salesforce Flows)

• Web Fundamentals: Solid understanding of web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

• Integrations & Security: Experience with Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP, Bulk) and understanding of Salesforce security models (profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, roles)

• Quality & QA: Strong focus on unit testing, debugging, and familiarity with automated testing frameworks (e.g., Provar)

• DevOps & Developer Tools: Salesforce CLI, version control (GitHub), and CI/CD tools

Desirable:

• Certifications: Advanced Administrator or Platform Developer, or System/Application Architect certifications are a strong plus

• Exposure to Salesforce Community Cloud (Experience Cloud) or other collaboration

It’s hard to believe that it’s 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We’re here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget. Our mission is to empower as many renters as possible with flexibility over their most significant recurring expense. We are seeking an experienced and visionary Staff Product Designer to serve as Flex 's highest-caliber individual design contributor. • Establish and evolve design standards, processes, and patterns that raise the quality floor for the entire organization

AI Fluency: Comfort using AI tools across the design process for research, exploration, prototyping, and workflow improvement

•
Passion: Genuine interest in financial products and improving people's financial lives

This is a contract position with an hourly rate

title: Senior Fraud Strategy Analyst
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

PARTNER EXCELLENCE HIGHLIGHTS

- You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

- Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

- A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

- Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

- A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

- Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Senior Fraud Strategy Analyst at Relay, you'll:

- Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

- Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

- Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

- Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

- Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

- Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

- Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust

title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert
description:
Role Title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a customer's project at the forefront of music and audio technology.
Your ears are the ground truth. You'll listen to short field recordings and document exactly what's audible - instruments, tempo, key, background sounds, crowd reactions - through a structured web platform built for this project. Later phases involve grading AI model answers against what you actually heard.
What you'll do

• Listen to 30-90 second field recordings (headphones, your own quiet workspace) and complete structured annotations: which instruments are present, tempo and key, timestamps of background events (traffic, sirens, applause), scene details

• Compare paired recordings of the same song captured at different locations and judge what stayed the same and what changed

• In later phases: review AI model descriptions of clips and mark what's correct, wrong, or invented, with a brief written explanation

• Attend a paid onboarding/calibration session and a short weekly sync

Who we're looking for (any of these backgrounds)

• Working or gigging musicians, session players, producers, or mixing engineers

• Music educators, ear-training instructors, band/choir directors, conservatory students or graduates

• Location sound recordists, sound designers, foley artists, or podcast/documentary audio editors

Requirements

• 3+ years of hands-on music or audio experience

• Strong analytical listening: you can pick individual instruments out of a busy, noisy, real-world mix - not just studio recordings

• Can identify tempo (within a few BPM) and musical key (relative pitch with a reference is fine)

• Comfortable with detail-oriented, repetitive annotation work in a web platform - dropdowns, timestamps, short structured notes

• Clear written English for brief, evidence-based notes (e.g., "accordion enters around 0:12")

• Quality headphones, quiet workspace, reliable internet

• Available 20-25 hrs/week for the engagement window

IRCA is a prominent international provider of semi-finished ingredients for the bakery, pastry, and gelato markets. They cater to independent producers as well as large food manufacturers, including consumer packaged goods (CPG) companies. The company's core product offerings consist of chocolate, chocolate decorations, creams, pastry mixes, gelato ingredients, and various other bakery and pastry ingredients.
 
The Receiving Clerk position is responsible for the receipt, verification, storage, and inventory management of raw materials and packaging materials. Ensures accurate system transactions, inventory control, food safety compliance, and timely material movement to support production operations. Coordinates inbound deliveries, maintains required documentation and records, and helps ensure materials are handled, stored, and rotated according to company quality, safety, and FIFO standards.

Irca Group offers career growth opportunities as well as competitive compensation and benefits:
Medical, Dental, & Vision, 401(k) matching, Paid Vacation, and Holidays, Employee Education Tuition Reimbursement Program

title: Automation Engineer
description: About Isembard Isembard is rebuilding industrial capacity through a connected network of factories. We bring skilled people, advanced machine tools and our own software, MasonOS, together to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics. The role Large, high-volume contracts mean our factories need to run around the clock. Overnight shifts can bridge the gap, but the long-term answer is automated machine tending. The market is crowded, with billet, vice, pallet and bar feed systems and many more, so rather than designing our own we work with external system integrators. You will own machine tending across our factories: choose the right solutions, manage the integrators who deploy them, and keep the cells running. You won't be designing and building cells yourself. Your job is to make sure the ones we buy deliver, and see them running on a live factory floor. The package includes equity. Scope automation projects and choose the right machine tending setup for each cell. Manage external system integrators through procurement, installation and commissioning. Own the performance and uptime of automated cells once they're live. Build a long-term procurement plan for automation as we add machines and sites. Work with operators on the floor so automation fits how the factory runs. What you bring Automation, controls or system integration experience in manufacturing, whether at an integrator, an OEM machine builder, a larger manufacturer with its own automation team, or a machine shop with serious machine tending.

title: Senior Strategic Account Marketing Lead

By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

You will take their account plans, what customers are telling us, and our revenue goals, and turn them into practical, creative marketing campaigns. title: Director, Product | Lab Archives
description:
Our Why At Dotmatics 

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform - best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics 

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. 

What We Need

We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Director of Product to lead the product organization for LabArchives, which comprises three SaaS products primarily serving academic and federal customers:  Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN), Inventory, and Scheduler.. You will own the product strategy, roadmap, and results for a platform that thousands of researchers and research organizations rely on every day. You are an operational leader who is AI fluent and adopts AI in the product strategy.  You build a product team that delivers, a commercial owner who understands pricing, renewals, and growth, and a product thinker who earns the respect of engineering. You will work in an modified agile software development environment alongside engineering, sales, marketing, customer success, and the wider Dotmatics organization.

We want someone who treats product as a business, not just a backlog. You know how to turn customer needs, market signals, and company goals into a focused roadmap, then run the team and the process that delivers measurable customer outcomes.

In this role you will get to

• Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for LabArchives, balancing the distinct needs of academic and federal customers working with the key internal stakeholders:  Enterprise and Customer Success, Sales, Engineering, and Business Leadership.

• Lead, coach, and grow the Product team setting clear expectations, building career paths, and raising the quality bar

• Own commercial outcomes for the product also including pricing and packaging

• Work with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success on go-to-market planning, launches, positioning, competitive analysis, and sales enablement

• Build and run the operating rhythm for product: planning cycles, roadmap reviews, prioritization frameworks, and status and metrics reporting to executive leadership

• Define the KPIs for the product, such as adoption, retention, net revenue retention, customer satisfaction, and release quality

title: Data Engineer
description:
As the Ops Data Engineer , you will support ANZ Operations and the wider supply chain by driving efficiency, managing operational complexity, and improving decision-making through data engineering, technical automation, and practical AI-powered solutions. You will own and enhance key data pipelines, identify high-impact opportunities for automation, and develop scalable applications that solve real-world operational challenges.

This role is based in Auckland and reports to the Senior Manager - Ops Data Engineering ANZ .

 

You will…

• Scale and optimize data pipelines, data quality, accessibility, and database efficiency to support reporting, automation, and AI workflows.

• Design, build, deploy, and maintain practical AI-powered applications, tools, and workflows that eliminate manual effort and streamline supply chain processes.

• Partner closely with business and operational stakeholders across Australia and New Zealand to translate business requirements into high-value technical solutions.

• Promote data and AI literacy across teams, championing the responsible and effective adoption of approved AI technologies.

• Implement robust engineering best practices, including version control, testing, lifecycle monitoring, and ongoing support for all deployed pipelines and applications.

• Ensure data and AI solutions adhere strictly to data security, privacy, access controls, quality assurance, and appropriate human oversight.

• Identify gaps in the existing tech stack, explore emerging technologies, and contribute directly to the team’s technical roadmap and continuous innovation.

 

You have…

• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• Strong programming experience in Python and SQL , with hands-on expertise building data pipelines, working with APIs, and managing databases.

• Familiarity with modern AI technologies, including generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI APIs, and how to apply them to operational use cases.

• A solid foundation in software engineering best practices, including testing, version control, deployment, and data security/privacy principles.

• Proven experience translating ambiguous operational requirements into reliable, maintainable, and cost-effective technical solutions.

You are…

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity, thriving in a fast-paced environment, and approaching complex problems with enthusiasm.

• An excellent communicator, adept at explaining complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

• Self-motivated, intellectually curious, and driven to learn and experiment with emerging technologies.

• A collaborative teammate who values knowledge-sharing, mentoring, and fostering a culture of continuous learning.

What you’ll get in return… 

 

• The chance to have a significant impact in a leading global food technology company

• Flexible working arrangements 

• Egoless environment, constant learning with room for personal growth

• Free access to Headspace

• HelloFresh Academies - internal learning & development 

• A diverse and vibrant international environment, with offices in 18 countries

• Competitive salary & benefits - 70% off HelloFresh

• Access to ClassPass corporate membership - 33 credits per month

Start Date: Immediately available - Can wait a notice period

Duration: Permanent full time role

Location: Penrose, Auckland - hybrid working environment 

Salary: Competitive salary & employee benefits

title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (all genders)
description: The role HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team. What you’ll do • Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets. • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions. • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalization and consolidation opportunities. • Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron’s for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients’ best interests - always.*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent - wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

* Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron’s top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics - including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron’s to use the ranking in marketing. Please see important information about the ranking criteria methodology  here .

About Fifteenth

Fifteenth by Mercer Advisors is a tax planning group built for new wealth. Our clients are tech employees, founders, VCs and investors. 

The role

We're hiring a Senior Tax Manager to lead client relationships and own the tax work for a book of tech clients. You'll review and sign returns, build projections, and give planning advice that helps clients make better decisions about their equity and income.

Our tax group is also rethinking how tax work gets done. We use AI and technology to work smarter and faster. We test new processes constantly and work directly with our engineers and product team to shape the tools we use. This role is a big part of that.

What you'll do

• Lead client relationships and be the main tax contact for your clients.

• Review and sign individual income tax returns, including complex multi-state and equity-heavy returns.

• Build and review tax projections, quarterly estimates and planning analyses.

• Advise clients on equity compensation: ISOs, NSOs, RSUs, ESPPs, 83(b) elections and exercise strategy.

• Help founders and investors with liquidity events, QSBS, fund K-1s and carried interest.

• Answer client tax questions clearly and quickly.

• Resolve tax notices and agency correspondence.

• Track tax law changes and explain what they mean for clients.

The Physical Engineering team sits within OpenAI’s Enterprise Verticals organization. We’re exploring how frontier AI can help people design, simulate, and build better physical products - shortening development cycles, improving product performance, and expanding what engineering teams can accomplish.

We’re building experiences within ChatGPT and integrations with tools such as CAD, eCAD, CAE, and simulation software to support engineers from early concepts through design, validation, and preparation for production.

title: Strategy & Operations Manager — Client Onboarding, Activation & Retention
description:
Wing Assistant is a venture-backed, Silicon Valley-based startup with global operations. We match US businesses with dedicated, fully managed remote professionals (executive assistants, customer service reps, healthcare admins, bookkeepers, and more) and run the delivery behind them: recruiting, onboarding, management, and support. We're also building exciting AI technologies to help clients get even more done across our Wing suite and sister companies we operate in the AI space.

Our talent and delivery teams are based in the Philippines; our clients are mostly in the US; our leadership works across Hong Kong and the US. We've scaled fast. Now we're obsessed with getting every customer we win live quickly, and keeping them for the long haul.

The Role

The biggest lever on Wing's growth is what happens after a customer signs: how quickly they get value, and how long they stay. We're hiring one person to own the entire post-sale journey (onboarding, activation, and retention) from the moment a deal closes to month 12 and beyond.

This is not an advisory role. You won't hand off a deck and walk away. You'll diagnose where and why customers stall or leave, build the systems and tools to fix it, and hold multiple teams accountable to the numbers. If you've spent years recommending changes and want to be the person who actually makes them happen, this is that job.

What you'll own

•
The onboarding pipeline. Every new account from signed deal to fully live. You know where every account sits, where it's stuck and why, and you make sure it moves faster.

•
Activation and early-life health. The first months decide whether a client stays. Define what a healthy start looks like, spot accounts going off track and intervene early.

•
Retention and churn as numbers. Define them, measure them and break them down (logo vs. revenue, early-life vs. mature, by role, segment, acquisition channel and team). Set the targets and own the trend lines.

•
Root-cause analysis. Funnels, cohorts, survival curves, leading indicators. Go beyond the dashboard into the qualitative and raw data to find what really drives outcomes.

•
Process improvement. Map the handoffs across teams, find the friction, redesign the process, run experiments and measure the impact.

•
Building tools. Vibe-code dashboards, alerts and workflow tools using Claude and other AI coding tools. Ship useful things in days, not quarters.

•
Deep data work. Write the SQL, reconcile the sources and build the models. When two systems disagree, you find out which one is right and why.

•
Stakeholder leadership. Work with sales, recruiting, customer success, finance, product and our Philippines operations team: people from very different backgrounds, functions and time zones. Drive change through clarity and evidence often without direct authority.

•
Reporting to leadership. A crisp weekly view of pipeline, activation and retention health: what changed, and what you're doing about it.

What success looks like

First 30 days: You've mapped the customer journey end to end, have access to every relevant data source, and have built trusted baselines for the metrics you own.

First 60 days: You've identified the highest-impact opportunities with hard evidence, launched the first interventions, and shipped your first tools.

First 90 days: You can show measurable improvement on at least one core metric, yourun a weekly operating cadence, and the tools you built are used daily by the teams.

Working Arrangements

•
Remote, full-time role . Occasional in-person meetings in Hong Kong.

•
Location: Hong Kong.

•
Hours: Our clients and many team members operate on US time. Your working day will generally run from the evening into the night, Hong Kong time. This is a core requirement of the role, not an occasional ask.

•
Travel: Occasional trips to our operation center in the Philippines.

•
Pace: This is an intense, high-ownership role in a fast-moving company. Expect high standards, tight feedback
